question: Estimate the average revenue per app install (LTV) for a fintech app in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Lifetime value of an average install (across all users, including the 90% that don't convert)? Yes.
Fintech app — investment platform like Groww? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Revenue per paying user × paying conversion.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Per Q26 analysis: ~1.5% of installs become paying users.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Average ARPU per paying user per year

calculationFlow: Average ARPU per paying user per year: ~₹800-1,200 (broking fees, premium subscriptions).
Plus non-paying users' value (network effects, referrals, free user advertising): ~₹15.
